Diopter Sight Open.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

H&K Export Sight.info: Iron sights found on the STG-91 series of weapons. These sights in particular are export models for some STG-91 rifles and features a rear sight with two aperatures.

Lyman Sight.info:
Flip up the Thompson's rear sight.
The Lyman sight was created specifically for the Thompson. It is primarily found on Soveran models of the weapon and exists on most Thompsons.

Aftermarket Sight.info: Special aftermarket iron sights for the M82A1!

Gen 3 Rear Sight.info: Equip the third generation (2016) AK-12 rear iron sight.

Double Open Sight.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

DT Siege Sight.info: The perfect sight for takin' down them no good dirty scoundrels held up in that thar' darn house!

Kalashnikov Sight.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

Unfolded Leaf Sight.info: Raise your leaf sight on your weapon. Leaf sights are hinged sights that can be raised up or down and adjusted to account for targets in range.

Bundeswehr Sight.info: Iron sights found on the MG3KWS. Press T for an LMG-style alternate aim mode.

Carry Handle Sight RRA.info: Iron sights found on M16 family weapons. These iron sights ditch that whole carry handle thing and give the aesthetic of some M16 iron sights without needing the carry handle.

Herstal Sight.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

DT11 Target Sight.info: An elevated sight typically used for target shootin'.

Half Ring Sight.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

Dual Aperture Sight.info: Iron sights found on the Vector. These sights were developed by Troy Industries and are unique with the rear sights diamond shape.

Carry Handle Sight ACR.info: Iron sights found on M16 family weapons. These iron sights ditch that whole carry handle thing and give the aesthetic of some M16 iron sights without needing the carry handle.

AAC Flip Up Sight.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

Izhmash Sight.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

KAC Sight.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

Steyr Sight.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

Carry Handle Sight.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

Diopter Sight.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

H&K Sight.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

Troy Flip Up Sight.info: Iron sights found on the SA58 SPR!

Valorise Irons.info: Iron sights from the FAMAS Valorise configuration.

IWI Sight.info: Iron sights found on the Tavor family of weapons. These sights have a very modern appearance to them with its rear sight ring and slim front post, making aiming a breeze.

Remove Irons.info: You prefer to aim your gun with no assistance?

Full Ring Sight.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

Quick-Release Sight.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

1200M Sight.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

Kel-Tec Sight.info: Iron sights found on the KSG 12. These irons were developed by Kel-Tec as flip up sights.

Super Slim Sight.info: Iron sights found on the UAR A3.

BUIS Sight.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

SVU Backup Sights.info: Flip up the SVU's built in ironsights!

Backup Sight.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

Sako Backup Sight.info: Alternate iron sights for the Sako TRG-42.

MBUS Sight.info: Iron sights found on the TRG-42. The Magpul Back Up Sight is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.
